verdict.rationale: Only community evidence touches transfer-in. One user describes entering EPP/auth codes from GoDaddy to transfer domains in, with the codes rejected and transfers needing to be redone (namecheap-comm-11). Another notes that transfers get special pricing while renewals are at full price (namecheap-comm-9). This confirms an EPP-based transfer-in flow and some pricing transparency concerns, but none of the first-party docs in the pack cover transfers. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the EPP/auth-code transfer flow, transfer status tracking, documented transfer pricing, and an explanation of what happens to remaining registration time.
